body:
Extended ldap/ber.prn with read-ber-length-ext/ber-header-size-ext (long-form BER length support, checked-live prerequisite for any real X.509 parsing) then built pentest/x509.prn's own real v0 slice (version+serialNumber extraction from a genuine Certificate/tbsCertificate SEQUENCE walk). Verified against an actual openssl-generated DER certificate, cross-checked against openssl's own -text/-serial output. make test: 348/348. Commit ddf45d1.

⚓ ☃
title: Real X.509 v0 (version+serialNumber) built on extended ldap/ber long-form BER
